errors.text_span: 这张饼图（图5）旨在展示单音名词作中心语的粘合式结构音节组配情况。图表共包含两个切片。
errors.evidence: The figure consists of two pie charts, not one pie chart with two slices. The machine-generated description incorrectly describes the layout.

errors.text_span: 右侧的橙色切片占据了较大的面积，目测约占整体的60%至70%；左侧的蓝色切片相对较小，约占整体的30%至40%
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly maps the slices: the right pie chart (sub-pie) is described as part of the left pie chart (main-pie). The main pie chart has a yellow slice (69.39%) and a blue slice (30.61%), not orange and blue.
The main pie's largest slice is 69.39%, not a vague 60% to 70%. The machine-generated description also fails to specify exact values.
The main pie's smaller slice is 30.61%, not a vague 30% to 40%.
The machine-generated description does not accurately state the chart's purpose (showing the composition of 'an' structures).
The description omits the sub-pie chart, which breaks down the '单音形容词 + 单音名词' structure by '的' visibility.
The description fails to mention the exact percentages and example counts (e.g., 229 例, 101 例) for the main pie slices.
The description fails to mention the exact percentages for the sub-pie slices (81.66% and 18.34%).
The description omits the gray connecting line between the two pie charts.
The description omits the labeling of slices with text and percentages.
The description omits the legend at the bottom, which explains the color coding (1=蓝, 2=橙, 3=绿).

errors.text_span: 由于该图表在视觉上呈现出高度模糊的状态，切片内部或周围并未显示任何具体的文本标签或百分比数值。
errors.evidence: The figure clearly shows text labels and percentages for each slice. This claim is false.
The figure includes a legend at the bottom. This claim is false.
The description is ambiguous about whether it refers to one pie chart with two slices or two separate pie charts.
The description uses vague estimates instead of precise values shown in the figure.
